QAV is an analog 
input card (-50 to +50 mV) of six channels from thermocouple, and QRT is an 
analog input card (-50 to +50 mV) from RTD and of 4 channels.

This document 
outlines the testing procedures P1 for QAV, QRT carts, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed 
Esmail Fouad & eng. Khalil Ahmed Awwad, QAV
tested at 10 
Nov. 2002, QRT tested at 05 April 2003 and revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by general
director: eng Mohamed Abdel Ghafar, and approved by 
eng. Yosery 
Mohamed Salama Head Sector of EL-Aresh Power Station.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the 
suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.
Unit must be shutdown.
Safety helmet, shoes,
Hand held Radio, wireless communications means.
Screw Driver, Nut Driver,
Isolating tape, and test leads.

Temperature 
 tester to inject Temp. or mV source according to thermocouple type.
mV source to inject Temp. according to RTD.

Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.

In case of 
 QAV, use thermocouple in mV according to Temp. table (thermocouple type J)

In case of 
 QRT, use RTD in mV source to Temp. according to Temp. 
 table (RTD)

Using 
 cabinet termination identify the location for the desired Card.

Using cabinet Termination list for each card Identify the input wires for the 
 first channel
Using the screw driver remove this two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the tester leads to the first channel .

In case of QAV inject mV to the channel according to 20 C, 50 C, 75 C, 100 C, 
 150 C, 200 C, 250 C, and 300 C

In case of QRT inject mV to channel according to the 20 C , 100 C , 200 C , 
 300 C , 400 C , 500 C and 600 C

Compare the mV injected using radio with the mV reading in the central control 
 room (CCR) .

If the reading is Ok or within the range (- + 0.01mV), repeat steps for the 
 another channels .
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the Card.

Remove the 
 jumper

Reconnect 
 the input wires to terminal strip.

Close the 
 cabinet.

Place a copy 
 of test result in the field maintenance file.

Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
QAV is an analog 
input card (-50 to +50 mV) of six channels from thermocouple, and QRT is an 
analog input card (-50 to +50 mV) from RTD and of 4 channels.
This document 
outlines the testing procedures P1 for QAV, QRT carts, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed 
Esmail Fouad & eng. Khalil Ahmed Awwad, QAV
tested at 10 
Nov. 2002, QRT tested at 05 April 2003 and revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by general
director: eng Mohamed Abdel Ghafar, and approved by 
eng. Yosery 
Mohamed Salama Head Sector of EL-Aresh Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the 
suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.
Unit must be shutdown.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, shoes,
Hand held Radio, wireless communications means.
Screw Driver, Nut Driver,
Isolating tape, and test leads.
Temperature 
 tester to inject Temp. or mV source according to thermocouple type.
mV source to inject Temp. according to RTD.
Work to be Carried Out
Steps to 
Prepare for test
Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.
In case of 
 QAV, use thermocouple in mV according to Temp. table (thermocouple type J)
In case of 
 QRT, use RTD in mV source to Temp. according to Temp. 
 table (RTD)
Using 
 cabinet termination identify the location for the desired Card.
Start Test
Using cabinet Termination list for each card Identify the input wires for the 
 first channel
Using the screw driver remove this two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the tester leads to the first channel .
In case of QAV inject mV to the channel according to 20 C, 50 C, 75 C, 100 C, 
 150 C, 200 C, 250 C, and 300 C
In case of QRT inject mV to channel according to the 20 C , 100 C , 200 C , 
 300 C , 400 C , 500 C and 600 C
Compare the mV injected using radio with the mV reading in the central control 
 room (CCR) .
If the reading is Ok or within the range (- + 0.01mV), repeat steps for the 
 another channels .
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the Card.
Return Card to 
Service
Remove the 
 jumper
Reconnect 
 the input wires to terminal strip.
Close the 
 cabinet.
Place a copy 
 of test result in the field maintenance file.
